$comment: Published contract of the answer of the credential endpoint. The handle is opaque and it never carries the secret: the schema has no field for a key, and the server never returns the secret in any response.
title: CredentialHandle

handle.description: The opaque handle of the credential. It identifies the secret in the vault and means nothing else.

created_at.description: When the server accepted the key.

expires_at.description: When the credential dies. After this moment the handle no longer works.
